Representative concurrent/offline replay passes.

items.improvement_direction: Record fit-for-purpose before/change/after evidence for recurring failure, recovery, rework, external calls and implementation completion. Connect intended result to before/after evidence, owner-declared material-change triggers, the next relevant review and actual outcome; report the evidence-level gap instead of calling fixture/CI activity real-world improvement.
exit_conditions: Material adopted growth changes have at least one relevant outcome signal where measurable.
Rules that add cost without demonstrated value can be adjusted or retired.
CURRENT_BEST updates cite outcome/regression evidence.

Representative owning project feeds a genuinely observed outcome and a materially changed source/action through this read-only path, and proves its own follow-up reduced a relevant failure/rework or improved the user result.

A CI-only or reference-only outcome cannot satisfy a separately required device, live-provider or operational evidence scope, and no observation alone promotes CURRENT_BEST or reopens CLOSED without new evidence.
A project-owned, source-locked actual work or learning outcome must be measured before any USER_OUTCOME_VERIFIED claim; a real CI observation alone does not satisfy this.

implementation_candidate.role: Deterministically classify owner-submitted observation evidence; no new AI, watch service, workflow scheduler or global semantic authority.
implementation_candidate.reference_origin: User-supplied eight-frame social carousel about a '24-hour trader'; method analogy only, NOT proof of the pictured author's system, trading outcome, safety or TAKY runtime.

Material source revision, repeated defect, or post-change outcome delta -> owner-scoped follow-up using actual evidence, no auto re-open of CLOSED.

items.title: Verify actual Google OCR provider against approved family intake and review draft
evidence: User clarification 2026-09-28: Google API OCR was researched but an actual provider call/application was not trialed.
TAKY CAP-OCR-INGEST-001 is a shared reference ingestion mechanism, not a live Google OCR test.
Hide PR #12 includes fixture-based family OCR adapter/browser flow and explicitly holds live OCR provider verification.
Ready product capture contract requires originals -> review draft -> Parent correction -> confirmed FACT.

Hide PR #12 hide-family-ocr-adapter.js constructs normalizedEvidence.request_id from its own outgoing ingest.request.request_id; the observed response processing does not independently establish a server-echoed trusted request id. TAKY validateForRequest on this locally rewrapped object alone is not proof of server/provider roundtrip correlation.

Owner draft routes for actual app-side use: Ready PR #113 and Hide V2 stacked PR #20; their CI outcomes must be checked per exact HEAD. These drafts do not establish a real Google provider call or deployed server echo.
items.improvement_direction: Do not rebuild the existing family capture transport or Hide vocabulary adapter. Compare Google Cloud Vision OCR/Gemini image input using synthetic nonpersonal ground-truth print/handwriting samples; keep source_id, per-field uncertainty, review-before-FACT, partial page retry and cost/privacy evidence. NVIDIA models remain optional independent research baseline, not automatic provider substitution.
exit_conditions: Real authorized provider invocation and exact model/API SKU are evidenced; fixture-only success remains separately labeled.
Field-level ground truth, printed/new-vs-review vocabulary/handwriting errors, latency and actual billed units are recorded.
No child/customer personal data is used during a trial by default; provider-specific terms and spend cap are verified before calls.
Ready owns family capture transport and Parent FACT confirmation; Hide only owns vocabulary pairing and interaction semantics.
Negative regression proves no OCR draft can become confirmed FACT or verified mastery without owning review/verification.
No production claim, paid auto-escalation, main merge or Netlify deployment from this candidate.

Authorized Ready /api/capture/analyze response correlation is independently checked: server echoes or securely binds exact request_id and allowed source ids; Hide compares returned binding before constructing a normalized result, rather than treating its own request id as provider proof.

Consumer adoption of validateForRequest is proven on exact owner branch/HEAD with multi-capture, excluded-answer-reference, retry and cross-batch negative regressions; central helper CI alone is not consumer migration.
